title: Grateful Dead Live at Ford Auditorium on 1972-10-30

ai_review.summary: Good audience tape with slight hiss captures a tight late‑1972 set featuring smoking China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Box of Rain and Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its beefy late‑'72 material, cohesive playing and strong transitions—especially the China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider medley and the sweet stretch through Box of Rain to Sugar Magnolia. The audience (AUD) recording is noted as clear with a pleasant ambience despite a slight hiss, making it an enjoyable listen for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of four reviews are 3‑4 stars and highlight both solid performance and acceptable audio quality; the weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear ambiance with slight hiss; no major dropouts, decent clarity for an audience tape.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Cohesive, rock‑n‑roll oriented set with smooth transitions and a long, satisfying run.
